title: Sacred Heart Memorial Hospital in Spokane, WA
author_note: Used for overweight heart patients who need to lose rapidly - usually before surgery
directions: Day 1 - all fruits except bananas.  Your first day will ocnsist of all fruit you want except bananas.  Melon lovers- day for you.  Two fruits that are lower in calories than most other are watermelon and cantelope.  Should you eat melon, your chances of losing 3 lbs. the first day are great.

Day 7 - Brown rick, fruit juice (unsweetened) and vegetables.  Again, STUFF, STUFF, STUFF……

Lose 10-17 lbs. in a week and feel like a million.  This seven day eating plan can be used as often as you like.  As a matter of fact, if followed correctly it will clean you system of impurities and give you a feeling of well being you never thought possible.  After only days of this process you will begin to feel lighter by at least 10 lbs., possibly 17 and have an abundance of energy.  Continue this plan for as long as you wish and feel the difference in both medical and physical disposition.

directions: Heat oven to 350 degrees.  Spray 2-quart casserole with cooking spray.
Cook ground beef or pork in 10-inch skillet, until brown; drain
Make rice mix as directed on package-except omit butter.
Stir rice mixture, soup, milk and pepper into ground beef.  Spoon into casserole.
Sprinkle with cheese and bake uncovered 5-10 minutes until cheese is melted and mixture is hot.

title: Orange Acorn Squash
directions: Put small amount of water in shallow dish
Put squash open face down in water
Whisk OJ, butter, brown sugar, nutmeg and cinnamon
Drizzle mixture on top of squash and bake open side down for 20 more minutes

title: Creamed corn for crock pot
ingredients: 2  bags (12 oz each) Green Giant Valley Fresh Steamers Niblets frozen corn, thawed
4 packages (3 oz. ea) cream cheese, cut into cubes
directions: Spray 3 to 4 qt slow cooker with cooking spray.
Spread corn over bottom of slow cooker
In a small bowl stir together remaining ingredients, pour cover corn and cream cheese
Cover and cook on High heat setting 2-3 hours.
Stir well before serving.  Corn can be held on low heat setting up to 2 more hours.  Stir occasionally.
For a little color, sprinkle thinly-sliced green onions on top just before serving

title: Spaghetti Casserole
directions: Mix with 1 large jar Spaghetti Sauce
Mix 8 oz softened cream cheese with sour cream and Mozzarelli cheese and green onion (optional)
Spread cheese mixture on hot spaghetti
Top with sauce and group beef mixture
Sprinkle with mozzarelli and parmesan/romano cheeses
Let set 10 minutes before cutting & serving

title: Chili
ingredients: 1  (15 oz) Brookes Chili Beans red beans with mild chili sauce
directions: Over medium heat cook beef, onion and chili seasons until meat is browned and onion is tender.
Add tomatoes with juice, tomato sauce, beans and water
Add seasonings and bring to a boil.
Reduce hat to low, cover and simmer at least 15 minutes

title: Chili
ingredients: 3 cups water (may want to use less and add as needed)
directions: Cook ground beef, onion, chili season together.  Drain if needed and transfer to large pan.
Add diced tomatoes, tomato sauce, kidney beans 1⁄2 cups water, chili powder and garlic powder, salt and pepper and green chili peppers

title: Texas Caviar
ingredients: 1 Can pinto beans, drained and rinsed
1 Can white shoe peg corn drained and rinsed
1 Can black beans, drained and rinsed
1 Can red beans, drained and rinsed
directions: Mix the sugar, vegetable oil and cider vinegar and bring to a boil and then let cool.
Recommended to do this first and let cool while preparing remainder of the ingredients.
Pour cooled sauce over remainder ingredients and refrigerate overnight.  Drain before serving and serve with chips/scoops.
Notes:  Keeps well due to vinegar but do not store in a metal container due to the vinegar.
